## Author checklist

- [ ] The release ZIP and checksum are versioned GitHub Release assets.
- [ ] The ZIP contains `qrate-plugin.json`, its root entry file, README, and root license.
- [ ] Manifest identity, version, API, license, and permissions match this record.
- [ ] The SHA-256 and byte size describe the exact uploaded ZIP.
- [ ] Old reviewed assets were not replaced.
- [ ] `npm run check` and `npm run validate:artifacts` pass.

## Maintainer checklist

- [ ] Publisher and stable distribution identity are verified.
- [ ] Source and release changes were reviewed.
- [ ] Permission and license changes were reviewed.
- [ ] CI's package inspection report matches this pull request.
- [ ] Revocation or replacement fields are correct, when applicable.
